notes.zh: 评注：迦拉特隆（遗物 r_galatron）激活时弹出，随机十选一的奖励各权重10：合金5000（出现两次）、能量8000、矿物8000、食物8000、次级文物300、稀有水晶500、易爆微粒500、消费品5000、异星气体500（events/caravaneer_events.txt:4338-4352）。获得途径见行商联盟主菜单的圣物箱（event-cara-333）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron (relic r_galatron) is activated; rewards are a ten-way random pick of weight 10 each: alloys 5000 (twice), energy 8000, minerals 8000, food 8000, minor artifacts 300, rare crystals 500, volatile motes 500, consumer goods 5000, exotic gases 500 (events/caravaneer_events.txt:4338-4352). It is obtained from the Reliquaries of the Coalition menu (event-cara-333).

notes.zh: 评注：通过战争目标 wg_take_galatron / wg_steal_galatron（及帝国版）夺得迦拉特隆时弹出，并设成就旗标 relic_robbery_achievement。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron is seized through the war goals wg_take_galatron / wg_steal_galatron (and the imperium versions); it sets the achievement flag relic_robbery_achievement.

notes.zh: 评注：失去迦拉特隆的一方弹出，并获得3600天的“颜面扫地”(humiliated) 修正。
notes.en: Commentary: shown to the side that loses the Galatron; it gets the humiliated modifier for 3600 days.

scope.zh: 遗物激活、夺取与失去三个窗口的触发和效果已核对。
scope.en: The triggers and effects of the relic activation, seizing and losing windows were checked.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现敌对一方的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the rival side appears here.
